messages:
Rae - Content: quick standup  need microcopy for tri-mode landing pages (Hosted / Dedicated / Private), 2 social captions, webinar CTA + routing map. Ship testable variants to staging by 5pm PT.

Tom (Growth): Ill do social captions + scheduling. Plan: announce post + reminder 24h later. Test angle A: cost savings; angle B: latency + reliability.

Ellen - PM: Ill draft subheads and webinar bullets. Focus outcomes: dev time-to-prod, predictable bills, and deployment safety. No hard numbers in copy.

Victor (Ops): routing rules: detect company_email, company_size, compliance flag. If enterprise signals present, send to enterprise-sdr with "priority:high". Draft mapping below.

```
form_type -> destination_queue (conditions)
contact:demo -> sales-enterprise (company_email OR company_size>200)
signup:trial -> growth-trial (company_email)
signup:self-serve -> freemium-onboard (personal_email)
question:compliance -> solutions-eng (compliance:true)
support:incident -> eng-oncall (severity:high)
```

Rae - Content: hero one-liners (pick/shorten):
Hosted: "Start building with production inference."
Hosted (alt): "Ship LLM features faster."
Dedicated: "Reserved GPUs for predictable throughput."
Dedicated (alt): "Committed capacity, reliable SLAs."
Private: "Run inference inside your network."
Private (alt): "VPC & on-prem for regulated apps."

Tom (Growth): social captions (drafts):
- Announce - Cost angle: "Lower per-token spend without sacrificing quality. See how Redwood routes and optimizes inference for Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments. Webinar + demo -> [link]"
- Announce - Reliability angle: "Keep LLM features dependable at scale. Predictable latency, transparent controls, private deployment options. RSVP for live demo -> [link]"
- Reminder (24h): "Demo tomorrow: choose the right deployment for performance, cost, and compliance. Join to see benchmarks + live Q&A -> [link]"

Ellen - PM: webinar headline + bullets:
Headline: "Practical Serving: Choosing Hosted, Dedicated, or Private for Your LLMs"
Bullets:
- "Benchmarks to watch: median latency, tail spikes, and effective cost/unit"
- "Decision guide: when to run Hosted, reserve Dedicated, or deploy Private"
- "Runbook: rollouts, fallbacks, and monitoring to avoid regressions"

Victor (Ops): ops notes: add utm_campaign=tri-mode-launch and event_id to forms. If company_size>1000 or enterprise_keyword present, set priority flag and include senior SDR in CC.

DeployBot: Content deployment window at 17:00 PT. Will push assets to /marketing/staging once files uploaded.

Rae - Content: assigning: Tom - finalize socials + UTMs; Ellen - finalize webinar bullets and subheads; Victor - confirm queue names in CRM and add flag logic; Ill compile the landing microcopy and upload to staging. Check back for quick signoff at 16:30 PT. :calendar:
